name: Sukina Ko ga Dansoujoshi de Siscon na Ken ni Tsuite!!
original_name: 好きな子が男装女子でシスコンな件について！！
source:
The girl he likes is a girl who crossdresses as a boy. And what's more, she has a severe sister complex!? The protagonist has a crush on his childhood friend, Yomi.
Even in middle school, their relationship remains the same, they're still best friends.
He knows there's no chance, but...
Will the protagonist still confess his feelings to Yomi?

[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/sukidan.html]official website[/url]]
